summary: Enhance your expertise in government securities with our comprehensive training course. Learn market operations and strategies to excel in this vital sector.
lede: Government securities markets and operations cover how public borrowing is issued, priced, traded and settled. Designed for public debt, treasury, central bank and fixed-income market professionals, the course supports practical decisions on issuance and liquidity. Participants learn to structure auctions and issuance calendars, interpret bond prices and yield curves, and assess secondary-market liquidity, settlement risks and debt portfolio trade-offs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for experienced professionals working with government securities, debt management, and fixed income markets. This course is designed for: Officials in ministries of finance or treasuries involved in public debt management. Central bank staff responsible for open market operations and government securities auctions. Debt management office (DMO) professionals overseeing issuance strategy and risk. Capital markets and securities exchange staff supporting listing and secondary trading. Primary dealer and commercial bank treasury staff active in government bond markets. Investment managers and analysts in pension funds, insurance companies, and asset managers. Risk and compliance professionals overseeing fixed income and sovereign risk exposure. Market infrastructure and post-trade professionals in clearing, settlement, and depository roles. Regulators and supervisors overseeing securities markets and intermediaries. Policy analysts and advisors working on capital market development and financial stability.
modules: Yield, Pricing, and the Yield Curve
Government Securities, Monetary Policy, and Liquidity Management
Debt Management Strategy and Risk Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial markets and public debt management principles. Prior experience in government securities or related financial markets will be advantageous.
